statement.zh: Jarrige《Pakistan Archaeology》24（1989）与 1996 CRAI 综述记录瑙沙罗早期至成熟印度河层位及仓储/手工业迹象。
statement.en: Jarrige’s Pakistan Archaeology 24 (1989) and 1996 CRAI synthesis record Early-to-Mature Indus levels and storage/craft contexts at Nausharo.
